# Finestres obertes

> A live map of webcams across the Catalan Countries (Catalunya, País Valencià, Illes Balears, Andorra, and l'Alguer) — clustered markers showing live video feeds and latest-capture stills.

Built with MapLibre GL JS over a trimmed CARTO basemap. The map itself ships no camera data — it's fetched at runtime from a separate API that is the sole source of truth for the camera list and each camera's live/broken status.

## Source

- [Site repository](https://github.com/rogerbaiget/finestres-obertes)
- [Camera data API repository](https://github.com/rogerbaiget/finestres-obertes-cameras-api)
